requirements.text: Walk every BGP from the single typed SPARQL algebra and preserve default/named/GRAPH-variable active-graph scope.
Apply W3C OWL Direct BGP-local variable typing and checksum-bound OWL signature declarations without leaking typing across BGP boundaries.
Classify OWL declarations, assertions, class/property axioms, restrictions, structural RDF and datatype facets; reject ambiguous, conflicting, unknown or unsupported forms fail-closed.
Classify independent BGPs in bounded deterministic CPU lanes so parallel scheduling cannot change legality evidence.
Bind every legality report to dataset, snapshot, query/algebra, active dataset, authorization set, OWL signature, datatype policy, profile qualification and consistency qualification.
Expose authenticated POST /v1/datasets/{datasetId}/sparql/direct/validate in Swagger/OpenAPI with authorization and dataset precedence before semantic access.
Require Phase 40.8 reasoner clients to consume a legal, identity-matching Phase 40.7 BGP decision and retain grounded OWL 2 DL checking.
Provide strict JSON Schema, independent validator, positive/negative fixtures, Rust tests, ancestry evidence and cumulative gates without enabling OWL Direct standards claims.
